ImmuCell Announces Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter Ended September 30, 2026

 

For Immediate Release

 

PORTLAND, Maine – October 12, 2026 – ImmuCell Corporation (Nasdaq: ICCC) (“ImmuCell” or the “Company”), an animal health biologics company that develops, manufactures and markets products to improve calf health and productivity, today announced preliminary, unaudited sales results for the third quarter of 2026.

 

Management’s Discussion: 

“Today we are reporting net income of $953,000 for the third quarter of 2026, a $1.1 million increase compared to the third quarter of 2025,” commented Timothy C. Fiori, Chief Financial Officer of ImmuCell. “Revenue grew 46.0% to $8.0 million in the third quarter of 2026 compared to the third quarter of 2025, a comparison aided in part by the absence of distributor restocking headwinds that had adversely affected the third quarter sales in 2025. Gross margin was 44.2% in the third quarter of 2026, which is 130 basis points higher than the third quarter of 2025 and reflects higher pricing and manufacturing execution partially offset by the previously discussed shift of certain product development expenses to costs of goods sold.” 

 

“We are pleased with our third quarter revenue and with distributor out-the-door volume growth of 18% over 2025,” commented Bobbi Jo Brockmann, Senior Vice President of Sales & Marketing. “Growth remained broad-based across our sales territories and product lines, supported by an increase in sales activity and continued progress in customer acquisition. We are also encouraged by inventory levels heading into our peak season as we shift our focus to the cow-calf market.”

 

“ImmuCell had a strong quarter. The expanded commercial team is delivering solid revenue growth as we reach more customers with our value propositions,” said Olivier te Boekhorst, President and CEO. “Increased commercial activity was supported by increased output from the manufacturing team. We are investing in capacity expansion and colostrum sourcing capabilities for future demand, and those efforts are projected to be completed on time and within budget.”

 

“We have negotiated a new, larger $3 million line of credit with our bank, which we expect to sign during the fourth quarter of 2026,” continued Mr. Fiori. “Additionally, given our strong cash position, we have terminated our At-The-Market offering.”

 

Certain Financial Results:

• Third quarter 2026 product sales increased 46.0%, to approximately $8.0 million, compared to the quarter ended September 30, 2025.

• Third quarter 2026 gross margin increased to 44.2% of product sales compared to 42.9% during the quarter ended September 30, 2025.

• Net income was $953,000, or $0.10 per diluted share, during the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to a net loss of $140,000, or ($0.02) per basic share, during the quarter ended September 30, 2025.

• Adjusted EBITDA (calculation methodology shown below) was $1.9 million in the three months ended September 30, 2026, as compared to $0.8 million in the three months ended September 30, 2025.  

 

Balance Sheet Data as of September 30, 2026:

• Cash and cash equivalents increased to $7.9 million as of September 30, 2026, from $3.8 million as of December 31, 2025, such increase benefiting in part from the $2 million settlement payment received in May 2026.  

• Net working capital increased to approximately $16.9 million as of September 30, 2026 from $13.0 million as of December 31, 2025.

• Stockholders’ equity increased to $32.8 million as of September 30, 2026 from $27.1 million as of December 31, 2025.

Non-GAAP Financial Measures: Generally, a non-GAAP financial measure is a numerical measure of a company’s performance, financial position or cash flow that either excludes or includes amounts that are not normally included in or excluded from the most directly comparable measure calculated and presented in accordance with GAAP. The non-GAAP measures included in this press release should be considered in addition to, and not as a substitute for or superior to, the comparable measure prepared in accordance with GAAP. 

 

We believe that considering the non-GAAP measure of Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) assists management and investors by looking at our performance across reporting periods on a consistent basis excluding certain charges from our reported income before income taxes. About ImmuCell: 

 

ImmuCell Corporation (Nasdaq: ICCC) is an animal-health biologics company that operates in the fast-growing market for calf health solutions. It develops, manufactures and commercializes the First Defense® line of products that provides Immediate Immunity™ through colostrum-derived, orally delivered antibodies against the principal viral and bacterial causes of scours. Scours (neonatal calf diarrhea) is one of the most prevalent and deadly diseases in neonatal calves worldwide. Press releases and other information about the Company are available at: http://www.immucell.com/investors.
